Definition: a bone (as strong); by extension, the body; figuratively, the substance, i.e. (as pron.) selfsame
BiblicalUsage: 1) bone, essence, substance; 1a) bone; 1a1) body, limbs, members, external body; 1b) bone (of animal); 1c) substance, self
